is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions previous studies that confirmed resistance and kdr-L1014F mutation frequencies in the area (page 3), but this study itself does not genotype any insecticide-resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data (counts or frequencies) are reported for the mosquitoes collected in this study.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in the Vallée du Kou, Burkina Faso (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical field study evaluating water management and swarm control.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in the villages of VK2 and VK3 in the Vallée du Kou, Burkina Faso (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from February 2024 to May 2024 (page 1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new field study conducted in 2024.

supplement.evidence: No genotype data were collected, so no supplementary data are needed for this purpose.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the impact of water-saving techniques (minimal tillage and intermittent flooding) and swarm control on Anopheles larval and adult densities in the Vallée du Kou, Burkina Faso. It does not perform any insecticide-resistance marker genotyping.
